note: NATO and allied exercise calendar. The run adds exercises with dates, lead, location and forces when announced, sets updated when dates change, and never deletes past ones (the page hides those older than 60 days). Feeds the Planner and the Horizon.

exercises.name: Avenger Triad 26
exercises.where: Command posts in France, Germany, the Netherlands and Poland
exercises.forces: About 4,000 personnel; V Corps, 2nd Polish Corps, 1st French Corps, 1 German-Netherlands Corps
src: USAREUR-AF, NATO Allies conclude Exercise Avenger Triad 26

exercises.name: Steadfast Defender 2027
exercises.forces: Live formations; tests Avenger Triad concepts
src: USAREUR-AF, NATO Allies conclude Exercise Avenger Triad 26

exercises.name: Koalicja (Multinational Force–Ukraine)
exercises.lead: France and the UK (MNF-U, operational HQ Paris); not NATO
exercises.forces: About 2,800 troops from 10 countries (FR 1,100, UK 300; BE, EE, DE, LT, NL, PL, ES, SE); drones and counter-drone, no tanks
src: Thousands of troops from Europe to rehearse post-war Ukraine deployment in Poland
European force to hold first Ukraine support exercise in Poland

exercises.name: Combined Resolve
exercises.where: Joint Multinational Readiness Center, Hohenfels, Germany
exercises.forces: 1st Armored Brigade, 1st Armored Division; more than 3,500 personnel from seven nations, about 50 Ukrainian soldiers
src: Ukrainian soldiers tap front-line experience to scout for US armor in Bavaria exercise

exercises.name: Resolute Reforger 2026
exercises.forces: About 3,000 personnel and 1,000 vehicles; recovery phase 4–8 Nov
src: NATO exercise Resolute Reforger 2026 in Latvia

exercises.name: Neptune Strike 26-4
exercises.forces: 17 allies; Italian carrier group (ITS Cavour), Turkish amphibious group (TCG Anadolu), UK carrier group (HMS Prince of Wales)
src: NATO says three maritime strike groups and forces from 17 Allies are testing joint combat readiness in Neptune Strike 26-4

exercises.name: Steadfast Dart 27
exercises.forces: Allied Reaction Force deployment; part of Steadfast Defender 27
src: Reconnaissance for exercise Steadfast Dart 27 by a SHAPE, JFCNP and NRDC-ITA delegation

exercises.name: Quadriga 27
exercises.forces: Includes Air Defender 27, 3–14 May, about 200 aircraft
